name: planka
description: Planka 2.x kanban over MCP: digest-first reads, verified writes, and the optional board workflow as skills.

planka_base_url.title: Planka base URL
planka_base_url.description: Origin of your Planka instance, e.g. https://planka.example.com. Use the final https:// URL: an http:// redirect drops POST bodies.

planka_api_key.title: Planka API key
planka_api_key.description: API key of the agent user (X-Api-Key). An admin creates it with POST /api/users/<id>/api-key and it is shown only once. Leave empty to fall back to PLANKA_AGENT_EMAIL + PLANKA_AGENT_PASSWORD in your environment.

planka_default_board_id.title: Default board ID
planka_default_board_id.description: Optional. Board used when a tool call omits boardId, so the agent stops spending a call to recover an ID that never changes.
